name: Build and Test 🚀✅

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ dev ]
    paths:
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Auth/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Admin/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Provisioning/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Auth.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Admin.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Provisioning.Test/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ dev ]
    paths:
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Auth/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Admin/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Provisioning/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Auth.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Admin.Test/**'
    - 'src/sdk/PnP.Core.Provisioning.Test/**'

jobs:
  build:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pnp'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read

    steps:
    - name: Wait for actions to finish
      uses: softprops/turnstyle@3805450be63b8c80577dc253e8c17e9132036df4 # v3.3.3
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}              
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
    - name: Setup .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
      with:
        dotnet-version: '10.0.x'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: dotnet restore
      working-directory: src/sdk
    - name: Build ⚙
      run:  dotnet build --configuration debug --no-restore --verbosity normal 
      working-directory: src/sdk   
    - name: Test 🧪
      env:
        pnpcoresdktestsite: ${{ secrets.PNPCORESDKTESTSITE }}
        pnpcoresdktestuser: ${{ secrets.PNPCORESDKTESTUSER }}
        pnpcoresdktestuserpassword: ${{ secrets.PNPCORESDKTESTUSERPASSWORD }}
        pnpcoresdktestclientid: ${{ secrets.PNPCORESDKTESTCLIENTID }}
      run: |
        dotnet test ./PnP.Core.Test/PnP.Core.Test.csproj --no-restore --verbosity normal --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
        dotnet test ./PnP.Core.Auth.Test/PnP.Core.Auth.Test.csproj --no-restore --verbosity normal --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
        dotnet test ./PnP.Core.Admin.Test/PnP.Core.Admin.Test.csproj --no-restore --verbosity normal --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
        dotnet test ./PnP.Core.Provisioning.Test/PnP.Core.Provisioning.Test.csproj --no-restore --verbosity normal --filter TestCategory=Offline --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
      working-directory: src/sdk
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov 📝
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        files: src/sdk/**/coverage.cobertura.xml

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
